2. Senator Marco Rubio (Florida)【assistant 10†commentary】  
3. Senator Jeanne Shaheen (New Hampshire)【assistant 10†commentary】

Senator Jeanne Shaheen holds a Master of Science degree from the University of Mississippi【assistant 23†commentary】 and therefore is the only one among those three that graduated from that institution.

**Answer:** Senator Jeanne Shaheen.
